cues: Ethanol is oxidised by acidified potassium dichromate.
Ethanol loses hydrogen from the alpha carbon and becomes ethanal.
Chromium is reduced from plus six in orange dichromate to plus three, which is green.
That orange to green change, measured along the tube, is the breathalyser.
